player_0.content: New plan: I failed because I repeatedly tried to "tratel" the mop to the "secti" while standing in the broom closet or hallway, where neither the mop nor the destination was visible. I did not first move the mop to a location where I could see both the mop and the target. The correct strategy is: 1) Go to the broom closet to pick up the mop. 2) Go to the living room (where the secti is). 3) Use the "tratel" command to move the mop from the broom closet to the secti in the living room. 4) Repeat this process for the plate (pick up in kitchen, move to secti in living room). 5) Finally, move the unpish from the nolog to the secti in the living room. I must ensure I am in the same room as the object before attempting to move it, and I must navigate to the target room before issuing the "tratel" command.
